## About
Fuller's Auto Body is a family owned and operated body shop in Lyons, Illinois. We repair collision damage, take out dents, and work to get your vehicle back to pre-accident condition.
When you've been in an accident, the paperwork can be as much of a headache as the damage. We handle the insurance side for you, and we also offer towing and car rentals. One reviewer, rear ended by a cab in Chicago, said Scott and Tom helped them talk to insurance and made them feel like family.
We're open weekdays and closed on weekends and public holidays. Stop by the shop on 45th St or give us a call.

## Services
- Auto body repair: Collision repairs aimed at getting your vehicle back to pre-accident condition.
- Dent removal: Our technicians work out dents so your vehicle looks good again.
- Insurance paperwork: We handle the insurance paperwork, so you have one less thing to deal with after an accident.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes. Estimates on our services are free.

Q: Can you tow my car or set me up with a rental?
A: Yes. We provide towing and car rentals.

Q: How soon will you call me back?
A: All customer calls are returned within 24 hours.
